hook.description: Alexander staring at his rugged, scarred reflection in a cracked mirror.
hook.evidence: The visual contrast of a man shedding his disguise and revealing his true, scarred identity is an immediate character hook.

candidates.reason: The transformation sequence builds intense anticipation for the protagonist's return to power.

hook.description: Alexander stepping out of a barn into the snow in full, immaculate ducal regalia.
hook.evidence: The sudden reveal of the protagonist in high-status attire after a rugged transformation is visually arresting.

candidates.reason: This sequence delivers the emotional payoff of the protagonist reclaiming his title and vowing to rescue his wife.

hook.description: A horse-drawn cart approaching royal guards at a cathedral entrance.
hook.evidence: The tension of an infiltration mission starting under the guise of a mundane delivery creates immediate stakes.

candidates.reason: The successful neutralization of the guards provides a satisfying action beat that establishes the protagonist's competence.
